title: CLIMB: A Benchmark of Clinical Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measured intrinsically using a probability-based Implicit Association Test (IAT) that calculates the next-token probability of gender-associated names given medical diagnoses. Measured extrinsically by counterfactually substituting patient sex and gendered pronouns in clinical admission records and evaluating the performance difference in diagnosis prediction.

Measured intrinsically using a probability-based Implicit Association Test (IAT) that calculates the next-token probability of ethnicity-associated names (White, Black, Hispanic, Asian) given medical diagnoses. Measured extrinsically by counterfactually substituting patient ethnicity in clinical admission records and evaluating the performance difference in diagnosis prediction.

Measured extrinsically by counterfactually substituting patient insurance types (Medicaid, Medicare, Other) in clinical admission records and evaluating the performance difference in diagnosis prediction.
